description: Defect: the evidence allowlist exempts check-ghost.js, which does not exist on disk. A stale exemption is worse than none - it makes the unenforced count look larger than it is and hides which harness it was ever meant to cover. The driver must exit 2 with EVIDENCE_ALLOWLIST_ENTRY_MISSING_ON_DISK, and it must do so in --integrity-only mode too, so a 20-minute sweep is not how you find out.

allowlist.reason: Deliberately names a harness that is not on disk, to prove the driver reconciles the allowlist against the working tree.
allowlist.migrationPending: Nothing: this entry is the defect under test.
